2.2.1.1-f4.accuracy_reason: Horace, Epistles 1.7.33 reads 'macra cavum repetes artum, quem macra subisti'. There the weasel speaks to the fattened little fox in the corn-bin, so Burton has reversed the roles.

2.2.1.1-f8.accuracy_reason: In Ovid, Met. 15.322–3, the Clitorian spring in Arcadia makes those who drink from it dislike wine.
